deep.reconstruction: There is no mathematics on this page. Folio [159r] is page 9 of a printed antiquarian or second-hand bookseller's catalogue, section 'Naturwissenschaft und Physik', running alphabetically from Ledermüller to Mayer. The previous page (8) and the next page (10) belong to the same catalogue. Each entry gives author, short title, format (8., 4., Fol.), place and abbreviated year, binding (br., Ppbd., Hlbfrzbd., Hlbldrbd.), an optional original price in parentheses in Thaler, and the sale price in Thaler and Silbergroschen. Years are printed without the leading '1': '860' means 1860 and '725' means 1725. The latest imprint on this page is 1861 (Leunis, 1r Thl. 861), so the sheet was printed in 1861 or later. That is well after the 1853 date in the bundle name. No handwritten annotations, marginalia or calculations by Riemann are visible. The only arithmetic present is the prices, which are not computations. There is therefore nothing to reconstruct. The sheet may have been kept as scrap paper or a book-buying list, or misfiled into the bundle.

transcription_corrections: The currency symbol rendered 'ℬ' is the printed Thaler sign (Reichsthaler abbreviation, often transcribed 'Thlr.' or '₰'-like 'ß'); it should be read as Thaler, consistent with the next-page transcription's 'Thlr.'
Linnaeus, 'idem. I. ?, II. 1. 2, III. 1. 2. 3, IV. 1. 2, A.': the first volume number is unclear in print. The transcription's 'I. 2' is a guess.
Magendie entry: there is a stray mark before 'Ppbd.' in the image ('• Ppbd.'); it is not part of the text.
This is not a Riemann manuscript: the content is printed catalogue text, and the dating note ('Leunis ... 1r Thl. 861') puts printing at 1861 or later, inconsistent with a 1853 notes bundle.
